_about: T678/T685: THE OWNER'S RULINGS ON SINGLE LINES for the coast cut (`pipeline.atlas.splits.coast`). The cut is one rule (RULINGS E21: a line is cut at the edge of the tidal water it enters; a water reaching the sea is fresh to the shoreline); a row here is a line the owner ruled on by hand, kept as written: `keep` cut at `cut_m` / whole / fresh, `decided` (the date, required) and `why`. `at` is the line's mouth (lon, lat). Written by hand only (owner rulings; Claude adds a row only from a recorded owner answer). Read by the atlas build (`build.cut_shores`, listed in the atlas's `coast_owner.json`).
